title: FUEL TANK FILLER DOOR
summary: Fuel tank filler door (gas door / fuel door on the rear deck) for all models: the round door, its emblem, and the bezel with the built-in hinge that sits in the filler opening. The door is screwed to the bezel hinge through washers, the bezel is screwed into clip nuts on the body opening, and a rubber bumper cushions the door; the screws are adjusted for a 4-6 lb opening effort.

parts.name: BEZEL ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Fuel filler door bezel assembly (with hinge)

parts.name: NUT
parts.name_expanded: Nut (clip nut on the filler opening flange)

fastening.note: Screw [4] with washer [3] goes through the hinge plate on the bezel into the underside of the door [1].
Nut [2] threads on a stud that comes through a hole in the door [1] from the outer face; the emblem [9] sits on the outer face with studs, so the nut appears to retain the emblem.
Screw [5] goes from inside the bezel [6] out through its wall into clip nut [7] on the flange of the filler opening.

notes: NOTE Adjust screws evenly to provide a 4 to 6 Pounds opening effort in the direction of arrow "A".
notes_internal: Item 1: binder hole covers the first two digits; visible '??' + '54544'.

Nut [2] to emblem [9]: the dashed lines are not fully clear; the emblem's studs point into the door, and nut [2] sits on the inner face over one door hole. Read as the emblem retainer but not certain.
Bumper [8]: shown pressed into the area next to the hinge; no fastener, so no fastening entry.
